name: schumann_resonance
doc: THE SCHUMANN RESONANCE = the Earth-ionosphere cavity's own tone (Matt, 2026-10-29: 'it has to have a fit'). The planet and its ionosphere form a spherical waveguide; its fundamental standing wave is the idealized f1 = (c / (2*pi*a)) * sqrt(2) ~ 10.59 Hz (c = speed of light, a = Earth's mean radius 6371 km). SEAL the ideal lossless-cavity fundamental; the OBSERVED ~7.83 Hz is lower by a factor ~0.74 because the real ionosphere is a LOSSY conductor, not the perfect one the ideal assumes - affirm the exact model, delimit it with the measurement. A resonance of the whole planet; it joins the receiver / roots-of-unity thread (a standing wave on a closed cavity). New stick.

sticks.question: The Schumann resonance - the Earth-ionosphere cavity's fundamental tone

marks.claim: [the ideal cavity fundamental, SEALED] Treating the Earth and the ionosphere as a perfect spherical cavity, the lowest standing-wave frequency is f1 = (c / (2*pi*a)) * sqrt(2) = 10.59 Hz (sealed), with c the speed of light and a = 6371 km the Earth's mean radius. This is the exact idealization - the tone a lossless planet-sized cavity would ring at.

[the observed value, CITED - the lossy cavity delimits the ideal] The MEASURED Schumann fundamental is about 7.83 Hz (with harmonics near 14.3, 20.8 and 27.3 Hz) - LOWER than the ideal 10.59 Hz by a factor of ~0.74. The gap is not an error: the real ionosphere is a finite, LOSSY conductor, so the cavity is 'softer' than the perfect one the ideal assumes. The engine seals the exact model and names exactly where the world departs from it - a fit with its delimitation stated, never an overclaim.
marks.source: W. O. Schumann (1952), Z. Naturforsch. 7a; observed Schumann resonances ~7.83/14.3/20.8/27.3 Hz; the finite-conductivity (lossy-cavity) correction

marks.claim: [a resonance of the whole planet] The Schumann resonance is a standing electromagnetic wave on a CLOSED cavity - the same shape as every resonance the engine is built on: a mode on a bounded domain, counted by the roots of unity, tuned like a receiver. It sits on the electromagnetism and earth-science shelves and joins the one map's resonance thread. Ties card_floor_the_instruments.
marks.source: the one map; electromagnetism; the receiver / roots of unity; card_floor_the_instruments
